lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zr4Zn4Sn4 (reduced formula ZrZnSn) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 12 atoms per unit cell across 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis gives each Sn and Zr center 12 geometric neighbors, and each Zn center 12 neighbors, with a uniform neighbor distance of 3.1659 Å and a close-packed-like local arrangement; the geometric neighbor graph is 3-dimensional and fully connected across all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Sn and Zr 12-vertex polyhedra, and edge- and face-sharing between Zr 12-vertex polyhedra.
